title: Rebounding oil exports through Strait of Hormuz are vulnerable to stepped-up Iranian tanker attacks
summary: Nearly 20 commercial ships have been attacked in the past month through the Hormuz chokepoint, threatening oil export recovery. This vulnerability poses risks to global energy supplies and international shipping security.
content: Nearly 20 commercial ships, mostly tankers, have come under attack over the past month while sailing through the Hormuz chokepoint.

zh.title: 通过霍尔木兹海峡恢复的石油出口易受伊朗油轮袭击威胁
zh.summary: 过去一个月内，近20艘商船在霍尔木兹要道遭受攻击，威胁石油出口复苏。这一脆弱性对全球能源供应和国际航运安全构成风险。

title: Wall Street is hyping AI. This fund manager is betting instead on fires, HVAC and Berkshire Hathaway.
summary: A Heartland Advisors co-portfolio manager advises investors to ignore AI hype and focus on practical companies that can leverage the technology as costs decline. This contrarian approach emphasizes value and established sectors over trend-chasing.
content: The co-portfolio manager at Heartland Advisors urges investors to shut out Wall Street’s hype on AI and look for companies that can use its technology as costs come down.

zh.title: 华尔街炒作人工智能，这位基金经理反而押注火灾保险、暖通空调和伯克希尔哈撒韦
zh.summary: 一位基金经理建议投资者忽视人工智能炒作，转而关注能够在成本下降时利用该技术的实用公司。这种逆向投资策略强调价值和成熟行业胜过跟风趋势。

title: Trump allows cheaper, dyed diesel on highways to blunt historic fuel cost spike ahead of midterms
summary: U.S. diesel prices hit a record $6 per gallon in September due to supply disruptions; the Trump administration is allowing cheaper dyed diesel on highways to reduce transportation costs. This move aims to address historic fuel price inflation before midterm elections.
content: The U.S. national average price of diesel topped $6 a gallon in September for the first time ever, as fuel supply disruptions pushed up transportation costs in the country.

zh.title: 特朗普允许在高速公路上使用廉价着色柴油以缓解中期选举前的历史性燃料成本飙升
zh.summary: 由于供应中断，美国柴油价格在9月创历史新高，每加仑达6美元；特朗普政府允许在高速公路上使用廉价着色柴油以降低运输成本。这一举措旨在应对中期选举前的历史性燃料价格通胀。

title: America’s renters are emerging as a political movement
summary: Young Americans facing indefinite renting are organizing for political influence as housing policy has traditionally favored homeownership. Tenants are increasingly seeking policy changes to address affordability and stability.
content: Housing policy has long prioritized homeownership.  As young Americans face the prospect of renting indefinitely, more tenants are seeking political clout.

zh.title: 美国租房者正在形成一股政治力量
zh.summary: 面临无限期租房的年轻美国人正在组织起来争取政治影响力，因为住房政策历来偏向房屋所有权。租户越来越多地寻求政策变化来解决可负担性和稳定性问题。

title: Russian lab worker's suspected plague death leaves some questions unanswered
summary: A Russian laboratory worker's suspected death from plague occurred amid reports that the situation is stable with no secondary cases confirmed. Questions remain about the circumstances and origin of the infection.
content: Russian authorities say the situation is stable and there are no reports of secondary cases.

zh.title: 俄罗斯实验室工作人员疑似鼠疫死亡留下未解之谜
zh.summary: 俄罗斯实验室工作人员疑似死于鼠疫，报告称情况稳定且未确认有继发性病例。关于感染的情况和来源仍然存在疑问。

title: Russia’s neighbor backs push to lift ban on nuclear weapons, prompting outcry from Moscow
summary: Lithuania is supporting efforts to lift bans on nuclear weapons to strengthen security amid Russian concerns. The move has drawn criticism from Moscow amid escalating regional tensions.
content: Lithuania is seeking to bolster its security amid growing concerns over Russia.

zh.title: 俄罗斯邻国支持解除核武器禁令，引发莫斯科抗议
zh.summary: 立陶宛支持解除核武器禁令的努力，以在俄罗斯关切的背景下加强安全。这一举措在区域紧张局势升级之际引起莫斯科的批评。

title: Here are Tuesday's biggest analyst calls of the day: Nvidia, AMD, Procter & Gamble, Meta & more
summary: Wall Street analysts issued major calls on significant tech and consumer stocks including Nvidia, AMD, and Meta on Tuesday. These recommendations reflect institutional sentiment on key industry players and market opportunities.
content: Here are Tuesday's biggest calls on Wall Street.

zh.title: 周二分析师关键评级：英伟达、AMD、宝洁、Meta等
zh.summary: 华尔街分析师周二对包括英伟达、AMD和Meta在内的重要科技和消费股发表重大评级。这些建议反映了机构对关键行业参与者和市场机会的看法。

title: Google makes a fresh bet on nuclear power as the AI energy crunch intensifies
summary: Google is pursuing nuclear power through a major deal with Constellation Energy as AI operations demand unprecedented energy consumption. The agreement represents a significant shift toward sustainable power infrastructure for data centers.
content: Constellation’s stock is rising sharply following a deal that equates to as much power as would be supplied by a new nuclear reactor.

zh.title: 随着AI能源危机加剧，谷歌再次押注核能
zh.summary: 随着AI运营对能源需求空前高涨，谷歌通过与康斯特莱申能源公司的重大交易追求核电。该协议代表了数据中心向可持续电力基础设施转变的重大举措。

title: Meta Muse gives AMD a boost as AI momentum shifts to personal agents
summary: AMD and Intel are gaining ground as AI development shifts toward personal agents, with Meta's Muse project driving growth. This momentum contrasts with underperformance of broader megacap tech stocks over the past month.
content: The personal agent boom is lifting the fortunes of AMD and Intel, which have outperformed their megacap tech peers over the past month.

zh.title: Meta Muse为AMD提供助力，AI势头转向个人代理
zh.summary: 随着AI发展转向个人代理，AMD和英特尔正在获得优势，Meta的Muse项目推动增长。这种势头与过去一个月更广泛的大型科技股表现不佳形成对比。

title: Car buyers are stretching loans to afford payments — it's a 'potential warning light,' analyst says
summary: Record numbers of car buyers took out 84-month or longer loans in Q3 despite rising prices pushing monthly payments to record levels. Analysts view this trend as a potential warning sign for auto market health and consumer debt stress.
content: A record number of car buyers took out 84-month or longer loans in the third quarter, but rising amounts financed are pushing monthly payments to new highs.

zh.title: 购车者拉长贷款期限应对支付压力——分析师称这是"潜在警讯"
zh.summary: 创纪录数量的购车者在第三季度申请了84个月或更长期限的贷款，尽管价格上升导致月供创新高。分析师认为这种趋势是汽车市场健康状况和消费者债务压力的潜在预警信号。

title: My wife never went back to work after raising our kids. Do I have to share my retirement savings 50/50?
summary: A spouse questions whether retirement savings must be split 50/50 when one partner stayed home to raise children while the other worked for 14 years. This raises complex issues about property division and spousal contributions in marriage dissolution.
content: “For 14 years I have gotten up every morning and gone to work while she has been free to pursue whatever interested her.”

zh.title: 妻子在抚养孩子后没有重返工作。我必须按50/50分享我的退休储蓄吗？
zh.summary: 一位配偶质疑当一方在家抚养孩子而另一方工作14年时，退休储蓄是否必须按50/50分割。这涉及婚姻解除中财产分割和配偶贡献的复杂问题。

title: America’s favorite index is misleading investors about the state of the stock market
summary: The S&P 500, long the standard market benchmark, increasingly reflects narrow megacap performance rather than broad market health. Critics argue it functions more as a distorted view than an accurate indicator of overall economic conditions.
content: For decades, the S&P 500 has been the preferred benchmark for monitoring the performance of the U.S. stock market. But these days, it is behaving less like a barometer of broad market health and more like a funhouse mirror.

zh.title: 美国最受欢迎的指数误导投资者对股票市场状况的认识
zh.summary: 长期以来作为标准市场基准的标普500指数，越来越多地反映狭隘的大市值股票表现，而非广泛的市场健康状况。批评人士认为它更像是一个扭曲的观点，而非整体经济状况的准确指标。

title: Google enters massive 3.6-GW power deal with Constellation Energy
summary: Google signed a major power agreement with Constellation Energy for 3.6 gigawatts involving nuclear capacity additions across multiple reactors on the U.S.' largest power grid. The deal addresses surging energy demands from AI operations.
content: Google has secured a huge power deal with Constellation Energy in the U.S.' largest power grid that involves adding nuclear capacity at several reactors.

zh.title: 谷歌与康斯特拉蒂翁能源公司达成大规模3.6吉瓦电力交易
zh.summary: 谷歌与康斯特拉蒂翁能源公司签署了一项重大电力协议,涉及美国最大电网上多个核反应堆的核电容量增加,总计3.6吉瓦。该协议旨在满足人工智能业务对能源的激增需求。

title: Stocks making the biggest moves premarket: Constellation Energy, Option Care Health, Lennar, P&G and more
summary: Multiple stocks including Constellation Energy, Option Care Health, Lennar, and Procter & Gamble posted significant premarket moves. These early trading swings reflect investor sentiment on upcoming earnings and broader market dynamics.
content: These are the stocks posting the largest moves in early trading.

zh.title: 盘前涨跌幅最大的股票:康斯特拉蒂翁能源、Option Care Health、莱纳和宝洁等
zh.summary: 包括康斯特拉蒂翁能源、Option Care Health、莱纳和宝洁在内的多只股票在盘前交易中出现了大幅波动。这些早期交易波动反映了投资者对即将公布财报和更广泛市场动态的看法。

title: CVS $20.5 million digital privacy settlement: See if you qualify and learn how to protect your data
summary: CVS Pharmacy agreed to a $20.5 million settlement in a class action lawsuit alleging it shared personal pharmacy data with third parties in violation of privacy laws. The settlement includes provisions for affected consumers to claim damages.
content: A class action suit alleges CVS Pharmacy shared personal data with an outside company, in violation of digitial privacy laws.

zh.title: CVS药房2050万美元数字隐私和解:了解您是否符合条件及如何保护您的数据
zh.summary: CVS药房同意就一起集体诉讼案件达成2050万美元和解,该诉讼指控其违反隐私法与第三方共享个人药房数据。该和解协议包括受影响消费者索赔赔偿金的条款。

title: Community supermarket opens in shopping centre
summary: A new social supermarket has opened in a shopping centre, offering shoppers access to budget-friendly groceries. This community retail initiative provides affordable food options to local residents.
content: Shoppers can access a wealth of budget-friendly groceries at the new social supermarket.

zh.title: 社区超市在购物中心开业
zh.summary: 一家新的社区超市在购物中心开业，为购物者提供平价食品杂货。这项社区零售举措为当地居民提供负担得起的食品选择。

title: World Bank warns of AI concentration risks as it lifts East Asia and Pacific growth outlook to 4.5%
summary: The World Bank raised its growth forecast for East Asia and Pacific to 4.5% this year, but warned about risks from concentration in AI-related goods. Trade growth outside AI has been weak or negative, signaling regional economies are becoming increasingly reliant on AI-driven commerce.
content: The World Bank now expects the region to grow 4.5% this year, but flagged that trade growth outside AI-related goods has been "weak or negative."

zh.title: 世界银行警告人工智能集中风险，同时将东亚和太平洋增长前景上调至4.5%
zh.summary: 世界银行将东亚和太平洋今年的增长预测提升至4.5%，但警告了人工智能相关商品集中带来的风险。人工智能以外的贸易增长疲弱或为负，表明区域经济越来越依赖于人工智能驱动的商业。

title: Little room for ‘giving and taking’: India’s finance minister confirms trade impasse with the U.S.
summary: India's finance minister acknowledged a stalled trade negotiation with the United States, stating there is little room for compromise. The statement signals growing uncertainty about reaching a bilateral trade agreement between the two nations.
content: In the latest sign of growing skepticism around the closure of the trade deal between New Delhi and Washington, an Indian minister said there is little room for ‘giving and taking.’

zh.title: "让步空间不大"：印度财政部长确认与美国贸易僵局
zh.summary: 印度财政部长承认与美国的贸易谈判陷入停滞，表示几乎没有妥协的余地。该声明表明两国达成双边贸易协议的前景越来越不确定。

title: Pentagon says Trump approves Army firing squad execution of Fort Hood killer Nidal Hasan
summary: The Pentagon announced that President Trump has approved the execution of former Army Maj. Nidal Hasan by firing squad for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting. Hasan was convicted by court-martial of killing 13 and wounding 32 others at the Texas military base.
content: Former Army Maj. Nidal Hassan was sentenced to death after a court-martial that convicted him of killing 13 and wounding 32 others at an Army base in Texas.

zh.title: 五角大楼称特朗普批准对胡德堡杀手尼达尔·哈桑进行枪决
zh.summary: 五角大楼宣布特朗普总统已批准对前陆军少校尼达尔·哈桑进行枪决，以回应2009年胡德堡枪击事件。哈桑被军事法庭裁定在这次德克萨斯军事基地事件中杀死13人、伤害32人。

title: Trump offers U.S. help to Russia after plague death; WHO assesses the situation as low risk
summary: President Trump offered U.S. assistance to Russia following a plague-related death, while the World Health Organization assessed the public health risk as low. The WHO said it was in contact with Russian authorities and remains prepared to provide support if needed.
content: WHO said it was in contact with Russian authorities, and has offered support if needed, while assessing the risk to the general public as low based on available information.

zh.title: 特朗普在鼠疫死亡后向俄罗斯提供美国援助；世卫组织评估风险较低
zh.summary: 在与鼠疫相关的死亡事件后，特朗普总统向俄罗斯提供美国援助，而世界卫生组织评估公共卫生风险较低。世卫组织表示正在与俄罗斯当局保持联系，并准备好在必要时提供支持。
